evidence: Indexed sitemap URL contained only three generic coming-soon placeholders.
expected_benefit: Avoid low-value or soft-404-like index entries
recommended_action: Apply noindex,follow and remove the URL from the sitemap until real contracts exist.

evidence: Generated 404 canonicalized to the homepage, had no noindex, and used relative assets that fail on nested missing URLs.
expected_benefit: Prevent incorrect canonical signals and preserve usable error recovery
recommended_action: Remove the 404 canonical and schema, add noindex,follow, and use root-relative assets/navigation.

evidence: Agent contracts used ProfilePage even though they describe source-linked software instruction contracts rather than people or organizations.
expected_benefit: Improve entity interpretation and factual schema alignment
recommended_action: Use SoftwareSourceCode with codeRepository, maintainer, publisher, and dateModified from visible/source facts.

evidence: Rendered card and detail images omitted intrinsic width and height attributes.
expected_benefit: Reduce layout instability and improve media readiness
recommended_action: Emit truthful square intrinsic dimensions for portrait and logomark placements.

affected_urls: homepage; agent directory; illustrated agent detail pages
evidence: Baseline Lighthouse transferred 5,078,406 image bytes on home, 3,949,942 on the directory, and 181,437 on the sampled detail page.
expected_benefit: Reduce transfer cost and improve lab rendering metrics
recommended_action: Resize portraits to 640×640 and encode optimized WebP assets.

evidence: Animated half-resolution ordered dither repeatedly processed hundreds of thousands of pixels on the main thread.
expected_benefit: Reduce total blocking time and CPU use while preserving the visual treatment
recommended_action: Render one static ordered-dither pass at one-sixth resolution.

evidence: Homepage and agent directory shared the same description; listing/home social images were absent.
expected_benefit: Make page purpose and social previews distinct
recommended_action: Give the directory a unique factual description and use the existing hero art for social previews.

evidence: Brand links resolved to /index.html instead of the canonical root URL.
expected_benefit: Keep internal link signals aligned with the declared canonical
recommended_action: Point sitewide brand navigation directly to /.

evidence: Agent last_updated values were not emitted as sitemap lastmod values.
expected_benefit: Provide accurate freshness hints to crawlers
recommended_action: Parse existing last_updated values and emit them as lastmod.

evidence: Both www variants failed DNS resolution in live production probes.
expected_benefit: Make common host variants resolve or redirect consistently
recommended_action: Create a Cloudflare/DNS www record and one-hop permanent redirect to the canonical host if the owner wants www support.

evidence: Generated _headers exists, but GitHub Pages did not serve its declared security headers through production.
expected_benefit: Apply defense-in-depth headers at the effective edge
recommended_action: Configure equivalent Cloudflare response-header rules; GitHub Pages does not interpret the _headers file.

evidence: No agents.kujolang.ai result appeared in the dated returned result sets for the four recorded observations.
expected_benefit: Establish indexing and discoverability rather than infer rankings
recommended_action: Verify properties and sitemap processing in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; remeasure after elapsed time.

evidence: Contracts are detailed and source-linked but do not include worked usage examples or version histories beyond update dates.
expected_benefit: Increase usefulness and citation-worthiness with genuine first-hand evidence
recommended_action: Add only real source-grounded examples, outcomes, and change history with editorial approval.

evidence: Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, analytics, CDN logs, field CWV, backlinks, and controlled AI-answer sessions were not accessible.
recommended_action: Grant read-only data access and repeat the stored query and AI benchmark sets.
